parts.html: The K-17 standard model is a gray U-shaped kitchen in a neoclassical style. The fronts are solid-colored, and the countertop is compact laminate.
Gray is a neutral, restrained color. It is easy to pair with light walls, natural wood, decorative plaster, stone, or metal, so the K-17 will fit into an apartment or a house.

The layout is U-shaped: 6.7 linear meters of furniture along three walls. There are plenty of work surfaces and cabinets for dishes and food, while the center of the kitchen stays clear — the model has no island.

The K-17 fronts use two materials: laminated chipboard for the wall cabinets and a foil-wrapped finish for the base cabinets. Both rows are the same gray, so the difference in finish is barely visible and the kitchen looks cohesive.
The kitchen carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard.
The cargo pull-out keeps food and small kitchen items close at hand. Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges close the doors smoothly, and the drawers run on concealed Muller runners.
Appliances in the K-17 are built into the cabinets. Handles are included; there are no lift-up mechanisms.
We adjust the cabinet sizes, the configuration of the U-shaped layout, and the placement of appliances to your room, taking into account where the utility connections are.
